task.title: Creating Look Aheads
task.shortdesc: Look Aheads allow designers to create field lookups for runtime users. Look Aheads allow users

context.p: Look Aheads allow designers to create field lookups for runtime users. Look Aheads allow users to replace existing records add new records with the values chosen from Search & Select action results or cells from the workbook. For example, a user can look up the account name when they are adding a new opportunity to the app. You can design two types of Look Aheads:

ul.li: Online: these lookups are real-time environment data and are more flexible than offline. See the procedure for details.

Offline: these lookups are for data that is already available in Excel (it might have been placed there from any source). For example, from a data invoking action (Query or Search and Select), data that was already in the template, or data that is generated from a macro into a list and made available to the offline lookup feature.

context.p: Look Ahead can be configured ONLY for Lookup Name fields. By default, the Search and Select (Online) is made available to configure Look Ahead. If there are no existing Search and Select actions, you can create a new Search and Select action using the new Look Ahead dialog.
Before creating a field lookup, you must have an existing field mapping in a Display or Save Map.
